# The BitBinder

> The BitBinder is a free, native iOS app for stand-up comedians and comedy
> writers. It combines joke writing, brainstorming, set lists, audio recording,
> on-device transcription, roast material, a lined notepad, and multi-format
> importing in one app. It works offline, requires no account, and syncs across
> a user's own devices through their private iCloud.

## Key facts

- Name: The BitBinder (also written "BitBinder")
- Platform: iOS (iPhone and iPad), native SwiftUI app
- Price: Free on the Apple App Store
- Audience: Stand-up comedians, open-mic performers, comedy writers
- Privacy: Works offline, no account required; data stays on device and, if
  iCloud is enabled, in the user's private iCloud database. Transcription is
  on-device (Apple speech recognition). Nothing is shared with third parties
  unless the user explicitly exports it.
- Maker: Taylor Drew

## What it does

- Joke library: write or dictate jokes, organize with folders and tags, star
  stage-ready "hits", recover deleted jokes from trash.
- Brainstorm board: capture rough ideas as cards or voice notes and promote the
  best into full jokes.
- Set lists: order jokes, estimate runtime, add venue/date, and use a
  performance view on stage.
- Recording and transcription: record practice or live sets (recording
  continues while navigating the app), play them back, and transcribe on-device.
  With iCloud on, the recorded audio also syncs across devices.
- Roast mode: dedicated roast targets, traits, and roast jokes, kept separate
  from regular material.
- Notepad: a single lined, scrollable notepad for freeform notes.
- Smart import: import from text, PDFs, photos, scanned pages, and audio; an
  import pipeline splits material into jokes and routes uncertain results to a
  review queue.
- BitBuddy: an on-device writing assistant that can analyze jokes and suggest
  edits without sending material off the device.
